'''The Motion Pictures Remastered''' is the 48th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 24 June 2022. The set consists of 134 cards.

[[The Continuing Committee]] released [[The Motion Pictures Remastered (expansion)|The Motion Pictures: Remastered]] virtual expansion set on 24 June 2022 giving the original expansion set new life with updated icons, game text, and high resolution images for a new era of First Edition. 82 cards from the [[The Motion Pictures]] [[Decipher]] set received errata in this expansion set.
